import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w = 0.4035
    c = np.cos(w*t); s = np.sin(w*t)
    return (params[0] + params[1]*v + params[2]*c + params[3]*s + params[4]*c*x + params[5]*c*v
            + params[6]*s*x + params[7]*s*v + params[8]*np.sin(v) + params[9]*v*np.abs(v)
            + np.sqrt(x)*params[0]*0 + params[1]*0)
